name: Shattered Sacrament
text: When Vigil fell to Tar-Baphon's Radiant Fire, that lost innocence brought you a deeper understanding of what faith means in the context of your own magic. When you cast a halcyon spell, you can choose for it to be a divine spell instead of arcane or primal. You gain a halcyon cantrip and a 1st-rank halcyon spell.
